description: This Java class is a mapper that converts between API Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) and internal provider models related to shipping quotes. It has methods to translate a QuoteRequest into a RateQuoteRequest for the provider, and to map provider quotes into a QuoteResponse for the API.

classes.name: ShippingQuoteMapper
classes.description: A Spring component that maps between API DTOs and provider models for shipping quotes.

methods.name: toProviderRequest
methods.description: Converts an API QuoteRequest into a provider RateQuoteRequest, aggregating total weight.

methods.name: toApiResponse
methods.description: Converts provider RateQuotes into an API QuoteResponse with mapping of individual quotes.
